description: This Kotlin source file defines a composable UI component 'ChatMarkdown' for rendering Markdown-formatted text within an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It includes functions for parsing Markdown, rendering blocks like paragraphs, headings, code blocks, lists, tables, and handling inline styles, images, and other Markdown elements.

classes.name: InlineStyles
classes.description: Data class encapsulating various inline style configurations for rendering Markdown elements.

classes.name: TableRenderRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row in a rendered Markdown table, including whether it's a header and its cell contents.

classes.name: ParsedDataImage
classes.description: Data class holding information about a parsed data URI image embedded in Markdown.

methods.name: RenderMarkdownBlocks
methods.description: Recursively renders Markdown nodes into corresponding Jetpack Compose UI elements.

methods.name: RenderParagraph
methods.description: Renders a Markdown paragraph, handling embedded images or styled text.

methods.name: RenderBulletList
methods.description: Renders a list of bullet points.

methods.name: RenderOrderedList
methods.description: Renders a numbered list of items.

methods.name: RenderListItem
methods.description: Renders an individual list item, including task list markers and nested content.

methods.name: RenderTableBlock
methods.description: Renders a Markdown table with scrollable support.

methods.name: buildTableRows
methods.description: Builds a list of table rows from a TableBlock node.

methods.name: readTableSection
methods.description: Reads header or body sections of a table into renderable rows.

methods.name: readTableRow
methods.description: Converts a TableRow node into a TableRenderRow containing cell data.

methods.name: buildInlineMarkdown
methods.description: Builds an AnnotatedString representing inline Markdown content starting from a Node.

methods.name: appendInlineNode
methods.description: Appends inline Markdown elements to an AnnotatedString.Builder.

methods.name: buildPlainText
methods.description: Extracts plain text from a Markdown node tree.

methods.name: standaloneDataImage
methods.description: Checks if a paragraph contains a standalone data URI image, and if so, parses it.

methods.name: parseDataImageDestination
methods.description: Parses the data URI image source to extract MIME type and base64 data.

methods.name: headingStyle
methods.description: Returns a TextStyle configured based on heading level for Markdown headers.

methods.name: InlineBase64Image
methods.description: Composably renders an inline base64 encoded image.
